'''Pidgebot 1''' (Japanese: '''メカポッポ1号''' ''Mecha Poppo 1'') and '''Pidgebot 2''' (Japanese: '''メカポッポ2号''' ''Mecha Poppo 2'') are a pair of robotic {{p|Pidgey}} seen in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. They are tour guides designed to show people around the [[Kanto Safari Zone]].

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===
Pidgebots 1 and 2 debuted in ''[[PS021|Long Live the Nidoking!]]''. They were used to guide {{adv|Red}} as he toured through the [[Fuchsia City]] Safari Zone. Despite Red being told that catching the [[wild Pokémon]] was not allowed, he managed to sneak in a {{i|Poké Ball}} to use. During the tour, Red came across a pair of {{p|Nidoking}} fighting over a {{p|Nidoqueen}}. Red attempted to catch one of the Nidoking, but the Ball missed and caught the Nidoqueen instead. Angered, the Nidoking began attacking Red, destroying the raft he and the Pidgebots were riding on. While Pidgebot 2 was destroyed, Red and Pidgebot 1 survived and were sent into the lake.

After making their way to shore, Pidgebot 1 chastised Red for breaking the rules and provided him with a [[Safari Ball]] to protect himself from the wild Pokémon. When one of the Nidoking managed to find Red and attacked, Red tried using the Safari Ball on it, but missed. Red was saved when Pidgebot 1 jumped in to save him, getting its wing destroyed in the process. Red retrieved Pidgebot 1 and managed to escape, later apologizing for getting them into the situation.

In ''[[PS022|A Hollow Victreebel]]'', Red and Pidgebot 1 were captured by a wild {{p|Victreebel}} in order to be used as nourishment to help a group of {{p|Bellsprout}} and {{p|Weepinbell}} [[Evolution|evolve]]. After waiting for the group to fall asleep, Pidgebot 1 used a [[Poké Flute]] to startle the sleeping Pokémon awake, allowing Red to throw a [[Poké Doll]] to distract them and free him from the vines keeping him captive.

As they tried to escape, the Nidoking from before appeared and began attacking the two. Red manipulated Nidoking to weaken one of the Victreebel, allowing him to catch it. With Victreebel, Red managed to weaken Nidoking itself, allowing him to catch it as well. Though victorious, more Nidoking and the Victreebel's comrades appeared to attack Red as well.

The next morning, Red and Pidgebot 1 managed to meet up with [[Baoba]], the Safari Zone staff, and Red's team. Red managed to survive by catching nearly all of the Pokémon that had attacked him.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
In ''[[PS298|Start the Countdown, Starmie]]'', a Pidgebot and Baoba saw the [[Team Rocket airship]] as it flew towards [[Vermilion City]].

==Other robots==
==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
In ''[[PS418|Deprogramming Porygon-Z]]'', an unnamed mechanical {{p|Starly}} appeared as a guide for the [[Sinnoh]] {{gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}}. It attempted to explain to {{adv|Platinum}} and {{adv|Looker}} about the various facilities, only for Platinum to reveal she had already memorized the information and recited it herself. Impressed by Platinum's intelligence, Looker shooed the Starly robot away. The Starly robot made further appearances throughout the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}, acting as a [[battle judge]] during most of Platinum's Battle Frontier matches.

==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===
In ''[[PS447|Fortunately for Feraligatr]]'', a robot {{p|Hoothoot}} appeared at the [[Johto Safari Zone]]. It and a member of the Safari Zone staff appeared to stop a battle between {{adv|Silver}} and [[Petrel]]. With his ability to disguise himself, Petrel took on Baoba's appearance and told the staff member that he and Silver were only playing. Convinced by the ruse, the staff member and Hoothoot robot left. 

==={{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}===
In ''[[PASM18|Confusion and Monsters from Another World]]'', a robot {{p|Fletchling}} (Japanese: '''メカヤヤコマ''' ''Mecha Yayakoma'') was given to {{adv|Sun}} by [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] so that he may communicate with them on his quest to gather all of {{adv|Zygarde}}'s [[Zygarde Cell|Cells]] and [[Zygarde Core|Cores]]. It was damaged by a {{p|Pheromosa}} when Sun passed by [[Po Town]]. Sun later repaired it by bandaging its head and body back together.
